from math import *
def pi():
    s1=1
    s2=1+(1/4)
    i=3
    while abs(sqrt(6*s1)-sqrt(6*s2)) > 0.000001:
        s1=s2
        s2=s2+1/(i*i)
        i=i+1
    return sqrt(6*s2)

print(pi())
